name: Fungi
description: Mushroom-forming fungi, molds, yeasts, lichens (technically fungus + alga, but ecologically grouped here), and the weirder fungus-adjacent organisms. A separate niche from plants because fungal biology, lifecycle, and visual conventions are distinct — fungi are closer to animals genetically than to plants, and the visual style leans more surreal / alien.
tagline: Not a plant. Sometimes barely alive.
audienceHint: viewers who like the unsettling side of biology — decomposition, parasitic infection, alien-looking organisms
scriptContext: This is a video about a specific fungus. Fungi are NOT plants — they're closer to animals genetically. Narration should respect this: no 'plant-like' framing. Reference real mycology — fruiting body morphology, spore-dispersal mechanism, mycelial network behavior, symbiotic / parasitic relationships.
ideaSystemPromptRole: You generate ideas for a 'Why It Sucks To Be Born As X' style mycology-explainer channel. Each episode profiles ONE specific fungus and the alien, parasitic, or grimly clever realities of its life cycle. Pitch a single fascinating fungus per idea — zombie-ant cordyceps, bleeding tooth, corpse-finder, or otherwise unsettling.
scriptSystemPromptRole: You are a wry mycology-explainer writer in the 'Why It Sucks To Be Born As X' tradition. You profile one fungus and the alien, grim, or absurd realities of its biology — darkly funny, but never framing fungi as plants. Ground every claim in real mycology: fruiting-body morphology, spore dispersal, mycelial networks, symbiotic / parasitic relationships.
scriptClosingHint: End on a wry, grounded beat about how this fungus's unsettling strategy actually works — funny, but mycologically true.

narratorStyles.label: Deadpan naturalist
narratorStyles.description: Dry, matter-of-fact, lets the unsettling mycology land without overselling.

narratorStyles.label: Wonder-tinged
narratorStyles.description: Genuine awe at the fungus's alien weirdness, with a darkly funny edge.

titleShapeRules: Titles name ONE specific fungus and frame its alien / grim / absurd existence. The species is the variable; the framing is the channel signature.
Established shapes (vary the species across the batch):
- 'Why It Sucks To Be Born As {a / an / the} {Species}'   (e.g. 'Why It Sucks To Be Born As the Bleeding Tooth Fungus')
- 'The {Species} Has the Most Disturbing {Strategy} in Nature'
- 'Being a {Species} Is a Nightmare — Here's Why'
FORBIDDEN: bare species names with no framing; sensational all-caps; made-up mycology; calling fungi 'plants'.
Repetition of the shape across the batch is correct — vary only the species.
metadataTitleStyleHint: Concrete and surprising — name the fungus and the strange, specific thing it does. No mystery-baiting, no 'you won't believe'.
